</Warning>

## Overview

Agenix is an AI agent SaaS template — users create agents with custom system prompts, tools, and knowledge bases, then run them via API or chat UI. Think a self-hosted version of OpenAI's GPT Builder.

## What's Included

- **Agent builder** — UI for creating agents with system prompts, temperature, and tool selection
- **Tool marketplace** — pre-built tools (web search, code execution, database queries)
- **Knowledge bases** — file upload → chunking → pgvector storage → RAG retrieval
- **Chat UI** — streaming chat interface per agent
- **API keys** — users generate API keys to call their agents programmatically
- **Usage metering** — track tokens per agent per user, enforce plan limits
- **Streaming** — real-time token streaming via Vercel AI SDK

## Database Schema

```ts
agents, agentTools, knowledgeBases, documents, embeddings, apiKeys, usageLogs
```

## Getting Started

```bash
npx create-launchkit@latest my-agent-platform --template agenix
```

## Required Environment Variables

```bash
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...           # For embeddings (text-embedding-3-small)
DEFAULT_AI_MODEL=gpt-4o         # Default model for new agents
E2B_API_KEY=...                 # Optional: for code execution sandbox
SERPER_API_KEY=...              # Optional: for web search tool
```

## Architecture

```
User → Create Agent → Configure tools + knowledge base
User → Start chat → API route → AI SDK streamText → Tool calls → Response stream
```

Agents are stored in Postgres. Knowledge base documents are chunked, embedded, and stored in pgvector. Each chat turn does semantic retrieval before generating.

## Key Files

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `apps/web/app/(app)/agents/` | Agent builder + list |
| `apps/web/app/(app)/agents/[id]/chat/` | Agent chat UI |
| `apps/web/app/api/agents/[id]/stream/` | Streaming API route |
| `packages/database/src/schema/agents.ts` | Agent schema |
| `packages/ai/src/tools/` | Built-in agent tools |

## Extending with Custom Tools

Add a tool in `packages/ai/src/tools/your-tool.ts` and register it in the agent builder's tool picker. Users can enable it per-agent.
